# C Device API

Initialise and drive one standard Portable Frame Protocol endpoint.

## `corelib_context_size`

```c
size_t corelib_context_size(void);
```

Returns the bytes required for opaque endpoint context storage.

Required context bytes.

## `corelib_context_alignment`

```c
size_t corelib_context_alignment(void);
```

Returns the alignment required for endpoint context storage.

Required byte alignment.

## `corelib_pending_request_entry_size`

```c
size_t corelib_pending_request_entry_size(void);
```

Returns the bytes required for one pending-request entry.

Required entry bytes.

## `corelib_init`

```c
corelib_status_t corelib_init(void *context_memory, size_t context_memory_size, const corelib_config_t *config, corelib_context_t **context);
```

Initialises an endpoint in caller-owned memory.

context_memory Suitably aligned writable context storage. context_memory_size Available context storage bytes. config Endpoint configuration copied by Corelib. context Receives the initialised opaque context on success. Status describing validation or initialisation success.


context Initialised context. Operation status.
